reason: The README clearly positions the plugin as a session handoff utility: users run `/handoff` to summarize recent chat, create a clean new session/agent in the same workspace, inject the summary as the first message, and auto-open the result while leaving the original session intact. This supports context transfer and session continuity as its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 该插件提供 `/handoff` 命令，可将近期对话总结为结构化交接文档，在同一工作区创建新的会话和代理，并自动打开新会话以延续后续讨论。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a `/handoff` command that summarizes recent chat context, creates a fresh session and agent in the same workspace, injects the summary as the first message, and opens the new session automatically.

capabilities: Summarizes selected conversation history with an LLM.
Creates a new session and agent in the same workspace from a handoff summary.
Automatically opens the new session in the client after creation.
Allows configuration of turns, input limits, token budget, model route, and timeout for summary generation.

reasons.code: README describes `/handoff` as summarizing recent conversation and creating a brand-new session+agent, using the summary document as the first message.
README notes recent conversation text is sent to the configured model to produce the summary, indicating data flow to the model endpoint.
